Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Deputy Advocate General for the State.

The respondent no.2, Mohd.
Sameer was granted bail on 08.08.2024 in First Bail Application No.1225 of 2024 in FIR/Case Crime No.40 of 2023, dated 19.02.2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Kotwali Pithoragarh, District Pithoragarh.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Now, a bail cancellation application has been filed.
Notices were issued to the respondent no.2.
But, now a report has been received from Kotwali Khatima, District Uhdam Singh Nagar that the respondent no.2 has been convicted and he is undergoing sentence in the same matter.
In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives in the bail cancellation application.
